engagement.population: Severe or moderately severe hemophilia B (FIX activity ≤2%)

engagement.model: FIX-knockout and normal mice given scAAV8.FIXR338L (BAX 335 / AskBio009)

safety.population: Severe or moderately severe hemophilia B (FIX activity ≤2%)

considered_not_added: DTX101 (AAVrh10-hFIX) preclinical NHP/mouse model: no published preclinical paper or stated predicted FIX level found; Pipe 2025 names no preclinical model. Patient miss (peak FIX 7-10 IU/dL vs 20 IU/dL target) has no model side to pair.

FLT180a (verbrinacogene) preclinical model (AAVS3 capsid, NHP/humanized-liver mice): no published preclinical study found; NEJM full text not accessible. Its AV-fistula thrombosis at FIX 260% could not be paired with a stated model prediction.
AAV5-hFIX (AMT-060) NHP dose-response for the dose cell: Majowicz 2019 gives NHP doses but no human FIX target; no source states an NHP-predicted patient level against Miesbach 2018's 4.4-6.9 IU/dL.

Human-genetic FIX Padua carriers (Simioni 2009, thrombophilia at FIX ~776%): no source found that compares it with gene-therapy patients; pairing with one FLT180a AV-fistula thrombosis would be confounded by the fistula.
Beqvez population PD model (SBRA): built on the Phase 1/2 and Phase 3 patients themselves to support dosing on adjusted weight; describes, does not predict, a patient result.
Beqvez human hepatocyte cell line in vitro transduction (SBRA): no comparison with patients stated or pairable beyond the draft's engagement entries.
Humanized-liver (FRG) mice / AAV3 capsid (Brown 2020): the AAV3 vector is not a class member and has no patient result.

Mouse toxicology with AAVRh74var-hFIX-Padua in healthy mice (SBRA, deaths with brain/skin findings): FDA attributed them to bleeding procedures in animals with endogenous FIX; no patient counterpart, not scored.
BAX 335 dose cell: mice gave a dose-linear 2-500% range but no stated human target exposure; not entered.
